business_problem: LALIGA needed powerful, portable hardware so clubs could access player-analysis data in real time from the sideline instead of waiting to review footage and reports later.
solution_summary: LALIGA standardized on Surface Pro 9 so coaches, analysts, trainers, and medical staff can use the Mediacoach application before matches, during play, and after the final whistle without leaving the touchline. The devices give every club portable access to high-quality data and video, letting staff compare images with performance metrics in real time and align tactical, physical, and medical decisions around the same information. Technical assistants can focus on different aspects of a match while coaches receive data-backed guidance on positioning, set pieces, and substitutions. LALIGA also trains club staff continuously so live data usage becomes part of each team's operating model. The result is faster analysis across 42 clubs and better support for decisions that protect player health and improve performance.

solution_components.name: Surface Pro 9
solution_components.role: Puts real-time performance and player-analysis data in the hands of coaches and analysts at the sideline.

business_outcome: Now every LALIGA club has real-time access to data that informs decisions to protect the health of players and improve outcomes for teams and the association overall.
